invariants.rationale: writeClient is dereferenced for method calls, so it is expected to be non-null.
instantTime is passed to writeClient methods and likely represents a commit/time instant, which should not be null.
preppedRecordInputs is passed as an argument to writeClient.upsertPreppedRecords and must not be null for correct operation.
If preppedRecordInputs is not empty, its elements should conform to the expected type.
instantTime should be a non-empty string for commit semantics.
